page.overview:
Who is Fennel?

Fennel is an alternate, gender-swapped version of Fern who exists in Fionna-world. She was introduced in Adventure Time: Fionna & Cake.

This alternate version of Fern has fair skin, long mint green braided hair with four white flowers in it, and a physique almost identical to Fionna.

She wears a light yellow t-shirt with 3-quarter-length sleeves, and two small white flowers on either side of the shirt's top; dark green short shorts with a white stripe along each side; medium-length white socks; forest green flats; and sometimes an olive-green square backpack.

In "The Lion of Embers" she wears a color-swapped version of Fionna's club outfit, which consists of a dark green long sleeve crop top, a shiny light green miniskirt, knee-high white go-go boots, and a white flower necklace. In this appearance she also has her hair half-up in a ponytail and wears a small flower clip to the right of her bangs.
